name: Trouble in the Deeps
summary: Tsunaman sends Horde travelers from Stonetalon Mountains to aid Je'neu Sancrea on Ashenvale's remote coast. The troll scholar waits at Zoram'gar Outpost, where danger gathers along the shore.

sections.title: A Summons to the Coast
sections.body: Tsunaman hears troubling reports from the north and calls on Horde travelers to reach Je'neu Sancrea. The troll scholar is at Zoram'gar Outpost, on Ashenvale's far western shore, the Zoram Strand. Je'neu faces mounting danger and needs help from beyond the outpost.

sections.title: The Road to Zoram Strand
sections.body: The road to Ashenvale's western shore is dangerous for Horde travelers. You can pass through Windshear Crag, disturbed by goblins, or travel north from the Barrens. Either way, you enter forest watched by night elf sentinels. Far beneath Ashenvale's dense canopy, Zoram'gar Outpost holds on along the storm-washed Zoram Strand, facing the shadowed waters.

sections.title: Whispers Below the Waves
sections.body: At the shore, Je'neu Sancrea points to trouble beneath the tides, in the sunken temple of Blackfathom Deeps. Ancient corruption, foul water elementals and Twilight's Hammer cultists gather there, stirring ancient evils. Je'neu looks to arriving champions to enter the submerged halls and face the terror rising within.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Trouble in the Deeps?
aliases: who starts trouble in the deeps
faq.answer: Tsunaman, in the Stonetalon Mountains, sends Horde travelers to aid allies along Ashenvale's coast.
Je'neu Sancrea is at Zoram'gar Outpost on the Zoram Strand, along Ashenvale's far western coast.

faq.q: How do you reach Zoram'gar Outpost from Stonetalon?
aliases: how to get to zoram strand
faq.answer: From Stonetalon, travel northeast through Windshear Crag into Ashenvale, or east through the Barrens and enter the forest from the south. Then head west from central Ashenvale to the Zoram Strand.

aliases: what is happening at zoram strand
faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea is watching the ruins of Blackfathom Deeps, where cultists and corrupted aquatic beings stir ancient horrors beneath the surface.

faq.q: What quest follows Trouble in the Deeps?
aliases: trouble in the deeps follow up
faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea sends you into Blackfathom Deeps to gather the elementally charged Sapphires of Aku'Mai from its tunnels.

faq.q: Why is the journey through Ashenvale considered perilous?
faq.answer: Night elves fiercely defend Ashenvale from Horde incursions. Hostile sentinels and hidden ambushers threaten travelers in the forest.

angles.text: As Horde, you help hold Zoram'gar Outpost on Kalimdor's western flank against night elf forces and coastal horrors.
As a shaman, you can read the disturbance in Zoram Strand's water spirits and help cleanse the corruption threatening them.
As a troll, you can aid Je'neu Sancrea, one of the Darkspears' foremost scholars, as he uncovers ancient mysteries of Kalimdor.
